newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq hit new high, tech stocks rebound.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq hit new high, tech stocks rebound.

text.p: Nasdaq shares rallied to a new record on Friday, following relentless gains in the Dow industrials and bolstered by a rebound in technology stocks.
The Nasdaq composite index gained 11.72 points, or 0.83 percent, to close unofficially at 1423.04, which tops the previous record close of 1412.04 set on June 9.

"It was a decent day, techs stocks were up a bit. Some of the big over-the-counter stocks are following the momentum of the Dow," which gained about 70 points to 7782, said Jack Bayer, managing director and head over-the-counter trader at Oppenheimer & Co.
Intel Corp recovered slightly from Thursday's losses, gaining 1-3/32 to 144-3/4. Other semiconductor stocks, such as Applied Materials Inc, also firmed.

Netscape Communications Corp dropped 1-1/16 to 32-1/4 after it said it was probing a possible bug in its Internet brower. The firm said it will offer a fix by early next week. ESS Technology Inc dropped about 14 percent after warning its second quarter growth would fall short of expectations. Advancing issues beat decliners on a margin of 11 to 10 on total volume of 602 million shares.
